text:
tara_ae: Heads-up — Acme PM wants a 6-week POC for an agentified customer support assistant. Scope: ingest ~1M docs, live chat + async summarization, eventual fallback to small private model. They want success criteria (latency, quality thresholds) and a rough cost/ capacity plan by EOD tomorrow.

matt_se: Quick sketch of their workload: 10k concurrent users peak, avg session 40 messages, avg 60 tokens per message. That’s ~24M tokens/day baseline, ~100M tokens/day peak. Need to confirm retention windows for context cache.

jordan_sre: @matt_se can you break that into qps and GPU sustained throughput? I need to check if Dedicated pools can handle the KV cache pressure.

matt_se: Sure — assumptions: 10k concurrent -> ~200 QPS sustained (assuming 50s avg session length), but peak bursts to ~800 qps for short windows. For model choices: gpt-style open model 33B quantized (int8) gives ~12 tok/ms on H100 with batching, A100 ~8 tok/ms. For 200 QPS with avg 60 tokens per request -> 12k tok/s -> ~1 H100 (sustained) or 2 A100s (buffer for bursts). For 800 QPS burst -> ~3x capacity -> recommend 3 H100s or H100 + burst autoscale.

tara_ae: Can you put that into cost terms for their 6-week POC (estimate compute + egress)? They asked for a single number range.

matt_se: Rough calc: use H100 on-demand price equivalent (Redwood Dedicated unit pricing) — simplified: $25/hr per H100-equivalent. Sustained baseline 1 H100 -> $600/day. If we reserve 3x burst capacity but only pay hourly when used, estimate 24h avg of 1.3 H100-equivalent -> ~$780/day -> 42 days -> ~$33k compute. Add storage + bandwidth + support: say $7k. Total ~ $40k for 6 weeks. If they want guaranteed 3 H100s reserved -> ~ $110k.

jordan_sre: Security note from questionnaire: Acme requires data-at-rest encryption with customer-managed KMS and audit logs for inference requests. Private deployment looks likely. That adds ops time for onboarding (2–3 dev days) and a small infra ops fee. Mentioned compliance: SOC2 + contractual NDA is needed.

matt_se: Also POC quality measurement: we should propose an eval harness with 500 seed prompts covering: retrieval accuracy, hallucination rate, length-of-answer compliance. Success: F1 >= 0.78 on retrieval tests, hallucination < 5% on sampled evals, 95th pct latency < 1.2s for chat median flow.

tara_ae: I’ll summarize for the customer. One more ask: they want to test prefix caching to reduce token cost; any estimate for cost delta?

matt_se: With prefix/KV caching the effective tokens per request drops from 60 -> 18 for many sessions (repeated context). That cuts token volume ~70% for chat flows -> baseline tokens/day ~7.2M -> compute/time drops similarly. Using that the 6-week estimate falls to ~$12k-$18k depending on burst behavior. We'll add note: caching effectiveness depends on session stickiness and prompt/template reuse.

jordan_sre: Operational blockers: Private requires VPC peering + customer IP allowlist. If they’re air-gapped we need on-prem package and an extra 5 business days. Also need to confirm KMS provider (AWS KMS vs Azure).

tara_ae: Good. Action items: 
- I’ll send Acme the POC one-pager with two pricing options (baseline w/ autoscale and reserved 3x).
- @matt_se to attach the token math and a short table comparing A100 vs H100 perf and cost.
- @jordan_sre to list onboarding tasks and compliance notes (KMS, SOC2, NDA).

matt_se: Will do — attaching quick snippet for token math they can paste into their doc:

```
# token math (example)
users_peak = 10000
avg_messages_per_session = 40
avg_tokens_per_message = 60
requests_per_day = users_peak * avg_messages_per_session = 400k
tokens_per_day = requests_per_day * avg_tokens_per_message = 24M
# with caching -> tokens_per_request ~18 -> tokens_per_day ~7.2M
```

tara_ae: Perfect. I’ll loop in legal for NDA and draft the two price options. Target: send to Acme tomorrow 10:00 PT.

ops-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 1772180000 (tomorrow 10:00 PT).

matt_se: One more thought — include a short eval plan for rollbacks: A/B test variant using quantized model vs full fp16 to validate cost vs quality. Recommend 10% traffic for 1 week.

tara_ae: Agreed. Thanks all, I’ll post the one-pager in this thread when ready. :rocket:
